name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump threatens Iran after Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's funeral saw calls for his killing
changes.summary: Trump made the comments on his Truth Social after U.S. officials demanded that Iran make a public statement saying the Strait of Hormuz is open. (Image credit: Iranian Supreme Leader Office).

changes.title: Trump Says Negotiations With Iran Will Continue as U.S. Ramps Up Strikes
changes.summary: U.S. forces hit more than 170 targets, including air defense systems, drone and missile storage sites, and military speedboats.

changes.title: Israel Struck an Iranian Steel Facility. Was It a Valid Military Target?
changes.summary: During the war, Israel attacked Iran’s steel plants, saying they provided forces with revenue and the means to make weapons, but it also hurt the civilian economy.

changes.title: Trump threatens to 'decimate' Iran if it tries to kill him, as Treasury sanctions alleged Iranian financier
changes.summary: Trump says 1,000 missiles are "locked and loaded" and will hit Iran if it carries out its threats to assassinate the U.S. president.

changes.title: Political scientist Dominic Tierney on why the U.S. gets trapped in conflicts like Iran
changes.summary: NPR's Scott Simon speaks with Swarthmore College political science professor Dominic Tierney about the U.S.-Iran war and other conflicts that have left the U.S. in drawn-out entanglements.

changes.title: Iran’s Top Diplomat Is in Oman for Talks on Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: The visit comes after heavy clashes this week between the U.S. and Iran. On Saturday, the country’s supreme leader vowed revenge for his father’s killing.

changes.title: Report says Iranian regime plotting to kill Trump
changes.summary: President Trump is also demanding Iran publicly declare it will re-open the Strait of Hormuz after Iran violated the ceasefire by firing on commercial ships. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

changes.title: The U.S. and Iran Are Fighting Again. Is the Cease-Fire Over?
changes.summary: Eric Schmitt, a New York Times National Security correspondent, analyzes recent skirmishes between the U.S. and Iran and whether they threaten ongoing negotiations for a peace deal.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Iran first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.
